AF-M15-05.label: Cooking for the whole party
AF-M15-05.premise: In a camp kitchen, the cheerful adult cook settles into a rhythm preparing a cozy meal for the party, while a sociable warrior stands by with the next crate of ingredients.

AF-M02-01.label: A dispute over quest pay
AF-M02-01.premise: In the tavern, two companions corner the snarky opportunist who holds the party purse, demanding to know why their share of the quest payout is suspiciously tiny.

AF-M07-01.label: Unveiling the perfect plan
AF-M07-01.premise: At the guild table, the strategist with glasses pushes them up with a gleam, ready to unveil his perfect plan over the map, while a familiar warrior waits to hear it.

AF-M08-01.label: A stuck kitchen jar
AF-M08-01.premise: In a quiet kitchen, the theatrical secret mastermind is handed a jam jar whose lid will not turn, while a companion waits for breakfast.

AF-M11-01.label: A confusing throne-room report
AF-M11-01.premise: In the throne room, the undead overlord stares in silence at a report he cannot make sense of, while his intensely loyal officer watches his every pause for meaning.

AF-M11-02.label: Rehearsing a victory speech
AF-M11-02.premise: Alone in his chamber, the skeletal overlord rehearses a commanding victory speech to celebrate finishing a routine administrative form.

AF-M11-03.label: A wish for the seaside
AF-M11-03.premise: In the war room, the undead overlord idly mentions wanting a quiet place by the sea, while his strategist officer and armored retainer hang on every word as an order.

AF-M11-05.label: Excusing a small mistake
AF-M11-05.premise: In the throne room, the undead overlord makes a minor mistake and improvises one grand-sounding sentence to cover it, as his eager officer begins taking notes.

AF-N13-03.label: An empty chair at court
AF-N13-03.premise: Before a visiting delegation, the elegant court schemer leans toward the ruler to admire why one chair at the table has been left conspicuously empty.

AF-N24-03.label: The forgotten red folder
AF-N24-03.premise: In the dark council chamber, the demon lord asks his sinister officer to explain the red folder on the table, because he has completely forgotten what is in it.

AF-N27-01.label: Filing newly arrived souls
AF-N27-01.premise: In the celestial records office, the reincarnation clerk opens her majestic ledger of souls to file the latest batch of arrivals, and notices they all share the same cause.

AF-P03-04.label: A suspicious treasure chest
AF-P03-04.premise: Deep in a dungeon, the worldly elf veteran identifies a treasure chest as a mimic and sternly warns the practical warrior to keep well back.

AF-P15-03.label: Asking the goddess for healing
AF-P15-03.premise: At camp, a wounded companion comes to the high-maintenance goddess healer for a simple healing, and finds her sobbing over a tangled ceremonial sash.

AF-P15-04.label: The party's overdue bill
AF-P15-04.premise: The goddess healer boasts that no disaster is beyond her miracles, just as an accountant arrives holding the party's overdue debt and waits for payment.

AF-P17-01.label: An ambitious day planned
AF-P17-01.premise: At dawn, the theatrical artillery mage writes out an ambitious to-do list of practice, errands and dungeon work, then begins with her one beloved explosion spell.

AF-P17-03.label: After the big blast
AF-P17-03.premise: In a scorched field, the artillery mage lies exhausted after a magnificent explosion, and her companion reaches down to help her up.

AF-P18-05.label: Closing time at the library
AF-P18-05.premise: As closing time arrives, the ancient small librarian sternly orders a regular visitor to leave, while a second companion glances at the reading table.

AF-P22-05.label: A gift for sparring
AF-P22-05.premise: In the training yard, the hot-blooded sword prodigy hands her sparring companion a carefully wrapped wrist guard, insisting it is purely for better practice.

AF-P28-01.label: A stain on abandoned notes
AF-P28-01.premise: In the empty council room, the hypercompetent sinister officer finds the ruler's abandoned notes marked with a tea stain, and studies it with deadly seriousness.

AF-P28-02.label: Asking about the plan
AF-P28-02.premise: In the war room, the ruler nervously asks the hypercompetent officer to explain the current plan, secretly hoping to learn what is actually going on.

AF-P28-03.label: A late royal order
AF-P28-03.premise: In the castle hall, a sheepish messenger admits to the hypercompetent officer that the ruler's order arrived late, and braces for the reaction.

AF-P28-04.label: Room to grow herbs
AF-P28-04.premise: In the council chamber, the ruler casually asks for a little more room to grow herbs, while the hypercompetent officer and an accountant lean in to take the request seriously.

AF-P28-05.label: Credit for a solved problem
AF-P28-05.premise: After a hard crisis, a teammate praises the hypercompetent officer for solving it on his own, and he immediately insists the credit belongs to the ruler.

AF-M03-05.label: Proof for the guard
AF-M03-05.premise: At a town checkpoint, the looping survivor confidently tells a guard he carries written proof of a threat he discovered on an earlier attempt, and reaches into his pocket.

AF-M19-03.label: Two requests for a walk
AF-M19-03.premise: In the manor garden, an adult suitor and an adult noble admirer each ask the oblivious villainess for a private walk, at the same moment.

AF-N28-01.label: Practicing a solemn face
AF-N28-01.premise: In her shrine, the indulgent goddess practices a solemn divine expression in the reflection of a polished offering plate still holding pastries.

AF-P44-02.label: An invitation to the garden
AF-P44-02.premise: The charming prince invites an adult noblewoman to admire the private garden he has carefully prepared for a romantic afternoon, and she arrives carrying a bag.

AF-N01-05.label: A result declared impossible
AF-N01-05.premise: At the guild counter, the appraisal examiner declares a newcomer's test result impossible and demands a retest, while the guild receptionist calmly reaches for her forms.

AF-N03-02.label: Reaching the measurement ceiling
AF-N03-02.premise: In the appraisal room, the examiner gravely announces that the unusually powerful hero has hit the measurement ceiling, and the hero looks up.

AF-P11-01.label: Plating a home-cooked meal
AF-P11-01.premise: In the kitchen, the horned ogre secretary proudly plates a meal she has carefully cooked for her household, and waits for the presentation to settle.

AF-M28-01.label: Catching up on lost decades
AF-M28-01.premise: In a modern living room, a present-day friend begins walking the awkward returned uncle through the decades of history he missed while away in another world.

AF-N12-03.label: A monster ruler visits
AF-N12-03.premise: In his manor, the pompous noble has prepared an elaborate defense for a monster ruler's visit, and the powerful ruler arrives with a simple practical question.

AF-N24-02.label: A lunch to discuss trade
AF-N24-02.premise: In a grand dining hall, the demon lord invites a nervous noble to a friendly lunch about trade, and the noble studies the menu with visible dread.

AF-P15-01.label: Proving her value
AF-P15-01.premise: Before the party, the high-maintenance goddess healer unrolls a presentation scroll intended to prove exactly how indispensable she is.

AF-P15-02.label: A suspicious tavern puddle
AF-P15-02.premise: In a crowded tavern, the goddess healer spots a suspicious puddle and grandly prepares a purification, right beside the keeper's experimental new drink.

AF-P15-05.label: A quiet night before departure
AF-P15-05.premise: At camp before an early start, the party's planner and a sleepy traveler ask the goddess healer for a quiet night, and she decides the camp needs a morale boost.

AF-P17-02.label: A locked pantry door
AF-P17-02.premise: In front of a locked pantry, the theatrical artillery mage proposes her ultimate explosion spell as the solution, while a practical companion stands beside her.

AF-P17-04.label: Hiring a demolition mage
AF-P17-04.premise: On a country road, a merchant hires the artillery mage to clear a boulder cheaply, while an accountant stands nearby with a notebook.

AF-P17-05.label: Practice at the target range
AF-P17-05.premise: At the training ground, the artillery mage begins a wonderfully elaborate incantation aimed at a practice target that her trainer is pulling along on a rope.

AF-M12-01.label: Touring the new home
AF-M12-01.premise: Deep in a cave, the talkative spider gives an enthusiastic inner-monologue tour of her newly woven home, pointing out its skylight, pantry and panoramic view.

AF-M12-02.label: A chief mistakes the spider
AF-M12-02.premise: In a dungeon corridor, a swaggering monster chief notices the little spider and dismisses her as harmless decoration, while she prepares to show what she has built.

AF-M03-01.label: Another morning at the inn
AF-M03-01.premise: After yet another involuntary reset, the looping survivor wakes at the inn as the innkeeper begins the same morning routine he has already lived many times.

AF-M03-02.label: A new checkpoint
AF-M03-02.premise: After another involuntary reset, the looping survivor finds himself at a new, further-advanced checkpoint and starts to celebrate his saved progress.

AF-M03-03.label: Warning about a floor tile
AF-M03-03.premise: In a trapped hallway, the looping survivor urgently warns a practical warrior never to step on the third blue tile, ready with an explanation.

AF-M03-04.label: Guiding the party past traps
AF-M03-04.premise: At a dungeon entrance, the looping survivor lays out a flawless route around hazards remembered from earlier attempts for two companions, one of them already eyeing a snack.

AF-M19-01.label: A friendly invitation arrives
AF-M19-01.premise: In her room, the oblivious villainess examines a friendly party invitation as if it were a map to her doom, while her childhood friend reads over her shoulder.

AF-M19-02.label: Packing for every ending
AF-M19-02.premise: Alone in her room, the villainess prepares for every remembered exile ending by learning farming, baking, sewing and trade, and begins packing the tools for all of them.

AF-M19-04.label: A red flag outside
AF-M19-04.premise: In the manor hallway, the villainess spots a red flag hung outside her room and braces for a remembered bad ending, as a maid walks by.

AF-M19-05.label: Rehearsing a villainous laugh
AF-M19-05.premise: In a parlor, the villainess asks a friendly noble to judge her intimidating laugh, determined to keep her fearsome reputation intact.

AF-N28-02.label: A balanced divine offering
AF-N28-02.premise: In the shrine kitchen, the indulgent goddess informs the cook that the cosmos requires a carefully balanced offering, and he asks what balance means.

AF-N28-03.label: An urgent prayer
AF-N28-03.premise: At the shrine, a hero kneels with an urgent prayer about a monster attack, while the indulgent goddess keeps glancing at the door for her promised dessert.

AF-N01-02.label: Turning in monster proof
AF-N01-02.premise: At the guild counter, the receptionist asks a beginner adventurer to place his monster proof on the counter beside her small counting tray.

AF-N03-05.label: A chart of adventurer ranks
AF-N03-05.premise: In the appraisal hall, the examiner shows off a chart ranking adventurers from dull gray to royal gold, the smug rival points at gold, and a plain newcomer steps up to the prism.

AF-M28-02.label: Old console, new television
AF-M28-02.premise: Alone in a modern room, the returned uncle uses astonishing magic to levitate his beloved old game console toward a much newer television.

AF-M28-04.label: Explaining a modern appliance
AF-M28-04.premise: In a modern kitchen, the returned uncle sets out to explain a simple appliance to a friend by comparing it to an obscure game mechanic from decades ago.

AF-M28-05.label: The most valuable keepsake
AF-M28-05.premise: At an antique shop, a dealer asks the returned uncle to show the most valuable artifact he brought back from another world, and he begins carefully unwrapping it.

AF-P06-02.label: Calming a heated argument
AF-P06-02.premise: In the guild hall, the strategist asks the exuberant wolf huntress to disarm a loud argument with an armed adventurer, and she bounds off eagerly.

AF-P11-05.label: An offer of second helpings
AF-P11-05.premise: At dinner, the horned ogre attendant offers a teammate seconds, and the teammate, already full, politely asks for the smallest possible portion.

AF-P18-01.label: Opening a sealed tome
AF-P18-01.premise: In the restricted stacks, the ancient small librarian slowly opens a terrifying tome sealed with multiple warnings.

AF-P18-02.label: A whisper in the library
AF-P18-02.premise: In a hushed library, a visitor whispers a quiet question about a book, and the ancient small librarian draws herself up to respond.

AF-P37-01.label: Inspecting a bowl of meat
AF-P37-01.premise: By the campfire, the food-motivated legendary wolf inspects a magnificent bowl of meat with ancient solemnity before allowing himself the first bite.

AF-P37-02.label: Guarding a supply delivery
AF-P37-02.premise: At the roadside, the cook asks the legendary wolf to guard a quiet supply delivery, and the wolf declares such a task beneath a creature of his stature.

AF-P37-05.label: The missing roast
AF-P37-05.premise: In the kitchen, the cook asks who took the roast that was left to cool, while the legendary wolf sits nearby in magnificent composure and a small slime watches.

AF-N01-03.label: A breathless revelation
AF-N01-03.premise: At the guild counter, a hero bursts in breathless with a world-changing revelation, just as the guild receptionist glances at the clock.

AF-M01-01.label: The smallest useful spell
AF-M01-01.premise: In the guild courtyard, the examiner asks the ordinary-looking cheat hero to cast the smallest useful spell he knows at a training target.

AF-M01-02.label: Consulting an ancient ruin map
AF-M01-02.premise: Alone deep in a dungeon, the cheat hero opens his divinely upgraded phone to consult the map of an ancient ruin and its ominous prophecy.

AF-M01-03.label: Recording an appraisal result
AF-M01-03.premise: At the guild counter, the receptionist starts writing the cheat hero's appraisal result on a tiny guild card, while the examiner keeps dictating more digits.

AF-M01-04.label: Buying a plain cloak
AF-M01-04.premise: In a clothing shop, the cheat hero, hoping to avoid attention, asks the merchant for their plainest cloak while an enormous ceremonial sword hangs at his back.

AF-M01-05.label: After solving the sage's puzzle
AF-M01-05.premise: In the sage's study, the cheat hero has effortlessly solved a magical puzzle and braces for the next impossible challenge as the sage picks up a pen.

AF-M02-02.label: Planning to win a raffle
AF-M02-02.premise: At a tavern table, the snarky opportunist spends the evening calculating how to win the tavern raffle without buying a single extra ticket, his bowl of free soup beside him.

AF-M02-03.label: Rescuing a stranded novice
AF-M02-03.premise: On a mountain trail, the snarky opportunist rescues a stranded novice adventurer while loudly announcing that the rescue comes with a fee.

AF-M02-04.label: A villain's grand introduction
AF-M02-04.premise: In a ruined fortress, a theatrical demon general launches into a long dramatic introduction, and the snarky opportunist raises his hand with a question.

AF-M02-05.label: A bargain map
AF-M02-05.premise: At a fork in the road, the snarky opportunist unfolds a bargain map with no legend he bought to save money, while the shrewd merchant who sold it is still nearby.

AF-M04-01.label: Lunch after a rockslide
AF-M04-01.premise: After effortlessly shielding a companion from a rockslide, the rejected defensive hero sits down to lunch and tries to cut the loaf of bread they packed.

AF-M04-02.label: A strict rule at camp
AF-M04-02.premise: Alone at camp, the rejected defensive hero firmly writes down a new rule: never again help strangers for free.

AF-M04-03.label: A handshake after a deal
AF-M04-03.premise: At a market stall, a merchant finishes a fair deal and offers a handshake to the suspicious defensive hero.

AF-M04-04.label: Denied at the gate
AF-M04-04.premise: At the city gate, a guard refuses the notorious defensive hero entry until a priestess who knows him can vouch for his identity.

AF-M04-05.label: Failing the practice dummy
AF-M04-05.premise: At the guild test grounds, the defensive hero cannot defeat a bulky practice dummy by attacking, while the examiner watches the clock.

AF-M05-01.label: Catching dinner
AF-M05-01.premise: By a river, a practical companion asks the gun-crafting survivor to catch dinner, and he begins unveiling an elaborate portable harpoon rig.

AF-M05-02.label: A journal entry about attachments
AF-M05-02.premise: Alone by the fire, the gun-crafting survivor writes in his private journal that attachments only slow him down, then starts packing his bag.

AF-M05-03.label: Seeking a rare alloy
AF-M05-03.premise: In a market, the gun-crafter asks a merchant for the rare alloy his ultimate weapon requires, and the merchant reluctantly checks his stock.

AF-M05-04.label: Warning about the red switch
AF-M05-04.premise: In the workshop, the gun-crafter warns two companions never to touch the enormous red switch on his newest weapon, and both look at it closely.

AF-M05-05.label: Promising any vehicle
AF-M05-05.premise: In the town square, the gun-crafter promises a merchant he can manufacture any vehicle she needs to get her goods out of town.

AF-M06-01.label: A lesson for the tutor
AF-M06-01.premise: In the study, the reincarnated child prodigy explains a difficult spell to the adult tutor with flawless terminology, wand eagerly in hand.

AF-M06-02.label: A diagram on the blackboard
AF-M06-02.premise: Alone in a classroom, the child prodigy draws a sophisticated magical diagram across the whole blackboard and arrives at the final symbol, high on the board.

AF-M06-03.label: Explaining the damaged wall
AF-M06-03.premise: Beside a scorched wall, the child prodigy prepares a frighteningly adult explanation for why another experiment went wrong, as a guardian and tutor arrive to listen.

AF-M06-04.label: Demonstrating a silent spell
AF-M06-04.premise: Late in the evening, the child prodigy begins demonstrating a clever silent spell for the patient sage, explaining every step at length.

AF-M06-05.label: Explaining to a craftsman
AF-M06-05.premise: In a workshop, the child prodigy impresses a local craftsman with a sophisticated explanation of material expansion, and the craftsman asks a follow-up question.

AF-M07-02.label: Inviting a guildmate to lunch
AF-M07-02.premise: Alone at his desk, the strategist with glasses begins drafting a decision tree for how to invite a guildmate to lunch.

AF-M07-03.label: Assigning movement routes
AF-M07-03.premise: Over a town map, the strategist assigns precise movement routes to a sociable warrior and a commercially minded merchant partner, and sends them out.

AF-M07-04.label: Preparing a negotiation
AF-M07-04.premise: At a tavern, the strategist has rehearsed an elaborate negotiation for dinner, and the hospitable tavern keeper approaches his table.

AF-M07-05.label: Presenting a battle plan
AF-M07-05.premise: Before the assembled party, the strategist confidently presents his battle plan, while a quiet scout studies the footnotes.

AF-M08-02.label: A moonlit warning
AF-M08-02.premise: Alone on a rooftop at night, the theatrical mastermind waits to deliver an ominous moonlit warning, cape ready, as clouds drift across the sky.

AF-M08-03.label: Inventing a secret organization
AF-M08-03.premise: In a back room, the theatrical mastermind invents a sinister secret organization on the spot while reading from a scrap of paper, as his earnest officer listens closely.

AF-M08-04.label: Practicing a civilian introduction
AF-M08-04.premise: At an inn, the theatrical mastermind asks the innkeeper to judge how he introduces himself, hoping to sound like a forgettable ordinary guest.

AF-M08-05.label: A dramatic revelation
AF-M08-05.premise: In a candlelit meeting, the theatrical mastermind pauses dramatically halfway through revealing a great secret, as his competent lieutenant leans forward.

AF-M09-01.label: Buying a spare bag
AF-M09-01.premise: In a shop, the obsessively cautious hero buys a spare travel bag in case his main one tears, and the merchant asks where he plans to carry it.

AF-M09-02.label: An ordinary door
AF-M09-02.premise: Alone before an ordinary wooden door, the cautious hero tests the grip, the hinge direction and his emergency retreat distance before trying to go through.

AF-M09-03.label: A free biscuit
AF-M09-03.premise: At an inn, the innkeeper offers the cautious hero a free biscuit, and he calls over a priestess to help him inspect it first.

AF-M09-04.label: Planning a harmless delivery
AF-M09-04.premise: At the guild desk, the cautious hero presents the quest clerk with an elaborate plan for a harmless delivery job, including a long list of expenses.

AF-M09-05.label: Mocked for a sewing kit
AF-M09-05.premise: At the trailhead, an impatient warrior mocks the cautious hero for packing a tiny sewing kit beside his enormous spare armor.

AF-M10-01.label: Naming a new settlement
AF-M10-01.premise: In a new settlement, the friendly monster ruler agrees to give it a friendly name, while a community chief and an administrator lean in eagerly.

AF-M10-02.label: Planning one public bath
AF-M10-02.premise: Alone on the floor of its office, the rounded monster ruler nudges planning tiles around with its body, starting with a single public bath.

AF-M10-03.label: Unveiling the street bins
AF-M10-03.premise: In the town street, the friendly monster ruler proudly unveils new public bins, while a visiting noble prepares an extravagant speech.

AF-M10-04.label: A broken workshop chair
AF-M10-04.premise: In an artisan's workshop, the adaptive monster ruler finds a broken chair and absorbs it to study the material, eager to help with the repair.

AF-M10-05.label: Settling a border dispute
AF-M10-05.premise: At a tense border meeting, the friendly monster ruler proposes a shared meal to settle the dispute, and the monster chief across the table considers the offer.

AF-M11-04.label: A sincere thank-you letter
AF-M11-04.premise: In his study, the undead overlord writes a sincere thank-you note to an innkeeper who helped him, and reaches for his enormous black seal.

AF-M12-03.label: Teaching an escape route
AF-M12-03.premise: In a cave, the talkative spider traces an elegant escape route in the dust with one leg while two bipedal allies watch and try to follow.

AF-M12-04.label: A celebratory cave snack
AF-M12-04.premise: After surviving a dangerous encounter, the talkative spider prepares to celebrate with a captured cave snack, as a curious slime creeps closer.

AF-M12-05.label: Appraising an unfamiliar stone
AF-M12-05.premise: In a cave, the talkative spider uses her basic appraisal skill on an unfamiliar stone, while a knowledgeable spirit floats nearby, ready to explain.

AF-M13-01.label: A briefing on safe pacing
AF-M13-01.premise: During a rest stop, the sentient sword lies across its feline wielder's knees and delivers a solemn mental briefing about stamina and safe pacing.

AF-M13-02.label: Reading an instruction book
AF-M13-02.premise: Alone, the sentient sword levitates an instructional book and turns its pages with telekinesis, growing absorbed in the reading.

AF-M13-03.label: An interview with the wielder
AF-M13-03.premise: At the guild, an examiner questions the feline wielder about her combat judgment, while the sentient sword on her back is eager to help.

AF-M13-04.label: Urgent advice during polishing
AF-M13-04.premise: At camp, the sentient sword tries to deliver urgent advice while its wielder conscientiously polishes the expressive emblem on its hilt.

AF-M13-05.label: A new sheath
AF-M13-05.premise: At the forge, a smith proudly offers the sentient sword a magnificent new sheath, and the sword begins asking questions.

AF-M14-01.label: A loose bridge plank
AF-M14-01.premise: Crossing a rope bridge on its carrier's back, the reincarnated vending machine spots a loose plank ahead and tries to warn her using only its preset sales phrases.

AF-M14-02.label: Counting stock after closing
AF-M14-02.premise: Alone after closing, the reincarnated vending machine proudly counts every remaining product in its display.

AF-M14-03.label: A reward for the machine
AF-M14-03.premise: In the town square, a noble arrives to reward the vending machine for heroic service, holding out a splendid commemorative coin while its carrier stands by.

AF-M14-04.label: A desperate drink order
AF-M14-04.premise: After a frantic sprint, an exhausted warrior begs the reincarnated vending machine for a drink, and it dispenses one instantly.

AF-M14-05.label: Moving the vending machine
AF-M14-05.premise: In the town square, the carrier moves the vending machine to a new spot, while a courier with a parcel approaches its old chalk outline.

AF-M15-01.label: A terrifying quest notice
AF-M15-01.premise: In the camp kitchen, the adult cook reads aloud a terrifying quest notice, while the legendary wolf who lives for his meals looks thoroughly unimpressed.

AF-M15-02.label: A secret modern condiment
AF-M15-02.premise: Alone in his kitchen, the adult cook uses his secret modern shopping skill to buy an ordinary condiment, and begins hiding it in a medieval jar for discretion.

AF-M15-03.label: An enormous catch
AF-M15-03.premise: In the yard, the food-motivated wolf proudly drops an enormous monster at the adult cook's feet, while a merchant waits to put a value on it.

AF-M15-04.label: A dragon refuses snacks
AF-M15-04.premise: In the kitchen, a proud dragon declares that legendary creatures cannot be bribed with snacks, as the adult cook holds a freshly finished plate.

AF-M16-01.label: Introducing a cleaning slime
AF-M16-01.premise: In a patron's office, the gentle child caretaker formally introduces his cleaning slime to a noble patron, complete with a job title and performance review document.

AF-M16-02.label: A staff handbook for slimes
AF-M16-02.premise: Alone at his desk, the gentle slime caretaker writes a painstaking staff handbook for his slimes, covering breaks, storage and gentle handling.

AF-M16-03.label: A cleaning demonstration
AF-M16-03.premise: At an inn, the proud slime caretaker prepares a cleaning demonstration and asks a visiting priestess and the innkeeper for a dirty cloth to clean.

AF-M16-04.label: A slime's well-earned break
AF-M16-04.premise: In his room, the gentle caretaker tells a hardworking utility slime it deserves a break, and settles it on a cushion beside a teacup.

AF-M16-05.label: Just a small hobby
AF-M16-05.premise: In his storeroom, the slime caretaker shows a merchant one improved cleaning method, insisting it is only a small hobby, as the merchant looks around.

AF-M17-01.label: Requesting a little paper
AF-M17-01.premise: In a merchant's office, the bookworm asks for a little paper, and the merchant begins explaining what producing it would actually take.

AF-M17-02.label: An empty bookshelf
AF-M17-02.premise: Alone in her room, the bookworm lovingly arranges an empty shelf for the books she intends to produce, preparing labels, sections and lending rules.

AF-M17-03.label: Pitching a paper-making plan
AF-M17-03.premise: In a workshop, the bookworm presents her brilliant paper-making plan to a local artisan and a protective friend, and the artisan has a question.

AF-M17-04.label: A jeweled book cover
AF-M17-04.premise: At a reception, a noble patron presents the bookworm with a lavish jeweled book cover to celebrate her achievement, and she eagerly opens it.

AF-M17-05.label: Signing a trade agreement
AF-M17-05.premise: At the negotiating table, the bookworm is about to sign an important trade agreement when she stops at an unfamiliar footnote, and the merchant braces.

AF-M18-01.label: Praise for a potion
AF-M18-01.premise: In her workroom, a knight grandly praises the overworked saint's extraordinary potion, and she begins asking him precise questions about how he used it.

AF-M18-02.label: Planning an afternoon off
AF-M18-02.premise: Alone in her lab, the overworked saint plans one afternoon away from work and begins her packing list with tea and a book.

AF-M18-03.label: Naming the new potion
AF-M18-03.premise: In the workshop, a noble insists the saint's newest potion needs a ceremonial name, while a merchant wants one short enough to fit the bottle.

AF-M18-04.label: Flowers from a suitor
AF-M18-04.premise: In her workroom, an adult suitor offers the overworked saint a bouquet during their agreed courtship, and she examines the flowers closely.

AF-M18-05.label: Finally time to rest
AF-M18-05.premise: Having finished her work early, the overworked saint tells her colleague she can finally rest, as the colleague arrives holding a basket.

AF-M20-01.label: A romantic entrance
AF-M20-01.premise: In the academy courtyard, an adult prince performs his expected romantic entrance for the otome heroine, who is waiting for the noblewoman she invited.

AF-M20-02.label: Annotating the route guide
AF-M20-02.premise: Alone at her desk, the otome heroine meticulously annotates the romance route guide she remembers from the game, pen in hand.

AF-M20-03.label: Too busy for flirtation
AF-M20-03.premise: In a corridor, the adult noblewoman firmly warns the otome heroine that she is much too busy for flirtation, and the heroine reaches into her bag.

AF-M20-04.label: A gift from the guide
AF-M20-04.premise: The otome heroine confidently presents her adult partner with the gift her remembered game guide recommends, and waits for the reaction.

AF-M20-05.label: A perfectly timed declaration
AF-M20-05.premise: In the parlor, the otome heroine, holding flowers, delivers a perfectly timed declaration toward the chair where her beloved sits in the remembered game, while a maid looks on.

AF-M21-01.label: A strict day of rest
AF-M21-01.premise: At her cottage, the cozy immortal witch tells a proud dragon visitor that today is strictly a day of rest, and the dragon eagerly offers to help.

AF-M21-02.label: A diary of tiny chores
AF-M21-02.premise: Alone in her cottage, the immortal witch reviews a diary of tiny daily chores repeated over centuries and walks out to her storehouse.

AF-M21-03.label: Handing out chores
AF-M21-03.premise: Hoping for a peaceful afternoon, the cozy witch assigns laundry to her dragon housemate and labeling to her elf artisan housemate, then leaves them to it.

AF-M21-04.label: A duel at the cottage
AF-M21-04.premise: At the cottage door, a hot-blooded sword fighter arrives demanding a duel with the legendary immortal witch.

AF-M21-05.label: Hunting for a spoon
AF-M21-05.premise: After effortlessly clearing a storm around her cottage, the immortal witch searches her kitchen for a missing spoon, while her ghost housemate drifts nearby.

AF-M22-01.label: Dress code at a reception
AF-M22-01.premise: At a formal noble reception, the costume-armored heroine arrives in her enormous animal suit with a tiny formal bow, and the host steps forward to object.

AF-M22-02.label: Hiding a conspicuous costume
AF-M22-02.premise: Alone in a shop, the costume-armored heroine buys a large cloak to hide her conspicuous animal suit and tries it on.

AF-M22-03.label: Called for an urgent mission
AF-M22-03.premise: In the guild hall, the receptionist calls the costume-armored heroine forward for an urgent mission, just as a local child tugs at her paw.

AF-M22-04.label: Inspecting the exceptional armor
AF-M22-04.premise: At the forge, a blacksmith asks to inspect the costume heroine's famous armor, and she holds out one padded animal paw.

AF-M22-05.label: Wrapping a small parcel
AF-M22-05.premise: In the guild hall, the costume heroine, who can smash dungeon barriers with her gloves, tries to tie a tiny ribbon on a parcel while a precise attendant watches.

AF-M23-01.label: Revealing the kingdom's salvation
AF-M23-01.premise: In the royal court, a noble asks the summoned pragmatic administrator to reveal the kingdom's salvation, and he asks to see the inventory records first.

AF-M23-02.label: One hour to think
AF-M23-02.premise: Alone in his office, the pragmatic administrator blocks one full hour on his calendar for uninterrupted thinking.

AF-M23-03.label: A statue for the reforms
AF-M23-03.premise: In the council chamber, a noble proposes a statue celebrating the administrator's fiscal reforms, and the accountant reads out the price.

AF-M23-04.label: A search for talent
AF-M23-04.premise: In the palace hall, the pragmatic administrator announces a search for extraordinary talents, and a warrior steps up to offer a spectacular combat display.

AF-M23-05.label: A balanced transport plan
AF-M23-05.premise: In his office, the pragmatic administrator proudly shows a merchant a beautifully balanced transport plan, and the merchant traces the shortest route with a finger.

AF-M24-01.label: Requesting a quiet posting
AF-M24-01.premise: In headquarters, the tiny reincarnated officer submits a carefully designed plan intended to earn her a quiet rear-area posting, and her superior reads it.

AF-M24-02.label: A map out of reach
AF-M24-02.premise: Alone in her office, the child officer climbs a stack of regulation manuals to reach the tactical map pinned high on the wall.

AF-M24-03.label: A speech about caution
AF-M24-03.premise: Before her unit, the child officer delivers a precise explanation of why nobody should take unnecessary risks, as a soldier and her superior listen.

AF-M24-04.label: Checking the supply count
AF-M24-04.premise: In the quartermaster's office, the child officer asks the accountant whether the unit has enough supplies, and he answers with great enthusiasm.

AF-M24-05.label: An aerial drill with coffee
AF-M24-05.premise: Over the training field, the child officer flies a complex aerial practice routine holding a full cup of coffee, while a veteran watches from below.

AF-M25-01.label: Reassuring a rescued traveler
AF-M25-01.premise: On a forest road, the kind skeleton knight rescues a frightened traveler and courteously reaches up to remove his helmet to reassure them.

AF-M25-02.label: Practicing a friendly face
AF-M25-02.premise: Alone before a polished shield, the kind skeleton knight practices a friendly, welcoming expression.

AF-M25-03.label: A dropped toy
AF-M25-03.premise: In a town square, a child asks the intimidating skeleton knight to find a toy dropped under a bench, as a guard approaches suspiciously.

AF-M25-04.label: Less conspicuous armor
AF-M25-04.premise: At the forge, the kind skeleton knight asks the smith to make his clanking armor less conspicuous, and the smith gets out an oil can.

AF-M25-05.label: Asking for little comfort
AF-M25-05.premise: At the inn counter, the kind skeleton knight explains to the innkeeper that he needs very little ordinary comfort, while his giant armor fills the doorway.

AF-M26-01.label: A well-repaired bag
AF-M26-01.premise: At a market stall, the young outcast tamer proudly shows a merchant her salvaged and repeatedly repaired bag, and the merchant offers a shiny replacement.

AF-M26-02.label: Packing an emergency kit
AF-M26-02.premise: Alone, the young outcast tamer sorts useful discarded objects into a carefully labeled emergency kit, pocket by pocket.

AF-M26-03.label: Choosing a reward
AF-M26-03.premise: At the guard post, a kind guard offers the young tamer a reward, and she hesitates over the valuable choices while her slime wiggles beside her.

AF-M26-04.label: Scouting a new inn
AF-M26-04.premise: Arriving at an inn, the wary young tamer carefully scouts for exits and safe storage, as the kind innkeeper comes over to show her around.

AF-M26-05.label: A collection of buttons
AF-M26-05.premise: In the market, a craftsman dismisses the young tamer's collection of discarded buttons as rubbish, while his own coat hangs loose.

AF-M27-01.label: Meeting a grown child
AF-M27-01.premise: In a city hall, the veteran elf avatar meets an impressive adult official who solemnly addresses her as mother and begins recounting a grand list of civic achievements.

AF-M27-02.label: An old familiar shortcut
AF-M27-02.premise: Alone, the veteran elf avatar follows a shortcut she remembers from her game days, confident it still leads where it used to.

AF-M27-03.label: A simple family meal
AF-M27-03.premise: In her home, the veteran elf avatar invites her two grown relatives for a simple meal, and they arrive carrying bags of documents.

AF-M27-04.label: Moving the inn table
AF-M27-04.premise: In an inn dining room, the veteran elf avatar offers to move the innkeeper's heavy table with a familiar high-level spell, while the innkeeper eyes the polished floor protectively.

AF-M27-05.label: A meeting at a cafe
AF-M27-05.premise: In an old merchant cafe, the ancient elf avatar sits down for a serious meeting, and the merchant, judging her by her youthful looks, politely hands her a simple illustrated menu.

AF-M28-03.label: Retelling an elf's gift
AF-M28-03.premise: In a modern living room, the awkward returned uncle recounts how an elf acquaintance once offered him a thoughtful gift, describing it proudly as a bargain to his present-day listener.

AF-M29-01.label: A new potion's bottle label
AF-M29-01.premise: In a fantasy pharmacy, the reincarnated pharmacist finishes a potion for a glow-in-the-dark hiccup curse and hands the bottle to the healer colleague who must understand its label.

AF-M29-02.label: Organising the pharmacy stockroom
AF-M29-02.premise: Alone in the pharmacy stockroom, the child pharmacist arranges every jar into a perfectly logical system, with the most frequently used supplies landing on the highest shelf.

AF-M29-03.label: Praise for a new tonic
AF-M29-03.premise: At the pharmacy reception, a noble praises the pharmacist's anti-sparkle tonic as wondrous while a clerk dutifully records the result for the official report.

AF-M29-04.label: Pricing a simple potion
AF-M29-04.premise: At the pharmacy counter, the pharmacist wants to sell a simple curse-removing potion at an accessible price, and a merchant suggests a gold bottle to inspire customers' trust.

AF-M29-05.label: Waiting for customers
AF-M29-05.premise: At the pharmacy doorway, the pharmacist has completed a long list of improvements to his potion and waits for customers, while the practical innkeeper next door looks over the shopfront.

AF-M30-01.label: A sealed dungeon door
AF-M30-01.premise: At a dungeon doorway, the ordinary handyman listens as the powerful archmage proposes increasingly destructive spells to defeat a sealed door blocking the party.

AF-M30-02.label: One leftover screw
AF-M30-02.premise: Alone at a quiet workbench after a dangerous expedition, the handyman empties his tool pouch and finds one leftover screw he cannot place.

AF-M30-03.label: Before the dungeon assault
AF-M30-03.premise: In a dungeon staging area, the warrior and mage stand ready for a grand assault while the handyman calmly holds a freshly glued handle in place.

AF-M30-04.label: A repaired strap at camp
AF-M30-04.premise: At a camp repair station, the handyman fixes the knight's damaged strap and apologises that the repair is completely unremarkable as he hands it back.

AF-M30-05.label: A formal lockpicking test
AF-M30-05.premise: In the guild examination hall, the guild master unveils an ornate locked chest and begins a long introductory speech about the handyman's formal skills test.

AF-N01-01.label: Preparing form drawers
AF-N01-01.premise: At her guild desk, the receptionist prepares three neat form drawers for the day: ordinary quests, unusual quests, and whatever the overpowered newcomer did.

AF-N01-04.label: Registering a new party
AF-N01-04.premise: At the guild counter, the receptionist approves a party's spectacular qualifications and asks the hero for one last detail: the party's name.

AF-N02-01.label: A trophy and a ledger
AF-N02-01.premise: In his office, the retired-adventurer guild master hangs a legendary monster trophy above his desk and opens the monthly maintenance ledger.

AF-N02-02.label: The no-pets rule
AF-N02-02.premise: In his office, the stern guild master calmly rehearses his strict ban on pets just as a tiny dragon familiar peers around the doorway.

AF-N02-03.label: A destroyed training yard
AF-N02-03.premise: In the guild office, the guild master folds his arms and demands that a reckless hero explain the destroyed training yard, and the hero braces for a confrontation.

AF-N02-04.label: A special applicant's test
AF-N02-04.premise: In the guild office, the guild master announces a special test for an exceptional applicant, who grips a sword expecting a combat evaluation.

AF-N02-05.label: Talk of retirement
AF-N02-05.premise: In the guild common room, the guild master tells a young warrior that retirement offers peace and quiet, as the receptionist approaches carrying a stack of paperwork.

AF-N03-01.label: Unpacking a new crystal
AF-N03-01.premise: In the appraisal room, the examiner carefully wraps a brand-new appraisal crystal in padding, adds a protective case and signs its warranty.

AF-N03-03.label: Doubting an absurd reading
AF-N03-03.premise: In the guild testing room, the appraisal examiner distrusts a prodigy's absurd result and tests a harmless training charm to prove the device works properly.

AF-N03-04.label: Registering a sentient sword
AF-N03-04.premise: In the registration laboratory, the appraisal examiner offers the familiar categories of warrior, mage and healer, and the newcomer's sentient sword starts asking questions.

AF-N04-01.label: After closing at the tavern
AF-N04-01.premise: In the tavern after closing, the veteran keeper flips the evening board from demon invasion to last orders and keeps polishing a glass beside a list of unpaid tabs.

AF-N04-02.label: A mysterious stranger
AF-N04-02.premise: In a village tavern, the hero excitedly describes a mysterious stranger whose identity took three quests to uncover, spreading an elaborate investigation map before the veteran tavern keeper.

AF-N04-03.label: A historic confrontation
AF-N04-03.premise: At the tavern counter, a theatrical demon general announces that this tavern will host a historic confrontation, while the veteran keeper keeps wiping the bar.

AF-N04-04.label: Ordering the house special
AF-N04-04.premise: In a roadside tavern, a tired warrior asks the veteran keeper for the legendary house special described in a hundred adventurers' stories.

AF-N04-05.label: A secret meeting spot
AF-N04-05.premise: In a tavern corner, an information broker whispers to the hero that this tavern is perfect for secret meetings, as the veteran keeper moves about the room.

AF-N05-01.label: Sorting abandoned linens
AF-N05-01.premise: In the inn laundry room, the practical innkeeper sorts abandoned linens into baskets for mud, soot and unexplained glowing residue.

AF-N05-02.label: A legendary sword at check-in
AF-N05-02.premise: At the inn reception, a hero proudly introduces the practical innkeeper to his legendary sword that can cut anything.

AF-N05-03.label: One room, two guests
AF-N05-03.premise: At the inn counter, the practical innkeeper has one room left for two exhausted adventurers, and both heroically volunteer to sleep on the floor.

AF-N05-04.label: A curse breaking at noon
AF-N05-04.premise: In the inn hallway, a magician explains that an ancient curse will break at noon and asks the practical innkeeper for just one more hour in the room.

AF-N05-05.label: A wolf at the inn
AF-N05-05.premise: At the inn entrance, a hero with an enormous wolf familiar asks the practical innkeeper whether the inn accepts monsters, bracing for rejection.

AF-N06-01.label: Mapping the day's errands
AF-N06-01.premise: At the inn kitchen table, the innkeeper's child draws a complicated map for the day's errands, marking every alley and shortcut in town.

AF-N06-02.label: Asking a hero to sign
AF-N06-02.premise: In the inn yard, the innkeeper's child shyly asks the famous hero to sign a sheet of paper, and he prepares a magnificent dedication.

AF-N06-03.label: Navigating the village
AF-N06-03.premise: On a village street, a veteran warrior explains to the innkeeper's child how he navigates dangerous terrain, while she carries a basket of bread on her errands.

AF-N06-04.label: Introducing a hero's companion
AF-N06-04.premise: On the inn doorstep, the hero strikes a dramatic pose to introduce the innkeeper's child to the terrifying creature that saved the town: his tiny slime familiar.

AF-N06-05.label: A bedtime story request
AF-N06-05.premise: In the safe inn common room, the innkeeper's child asks an armoured knight for a bedtime story, and he begins a meticulous account of battle formations and supply lines.

AF-N07-01.label: A speech in the forge
AF-N07-01.premise: Alone in the forge, the gruff dwarf smith gives a moving speech about loyalty, hard work and being taken for granted, his lunch untouched beside him.

AF-N07-02.label: An absurd commission
AF-N07-02.premise: In the blacksmith shop, the gruff dwarf smith declares that no amount of money will make him accept the hero's absurd commission, as the hero reaches into a pouch.

AF-N07-03.label: A jewelled sword request
AF-N07-03.premise: At the forge counter, a status-conscious noble asks the gruff dwarf smith to add jewels everywhere on a new sword.

AF-N07-04.label: A sword broken in battle
AF-N07-04.premise: At the forge inspection bench, a hero hands the gruff dwarf smith a damaged sword, claiming it broke during an epic battle.

AF-N07-05.label: Sketching a modern gadget
AF-N07-05.premise: In a shared workshop, the newcomer from another world sketches a modern gadget and tells the dwarf smith and the detail-minded artisan it should be easy to build.

AF-N08-01.label: A lamp with seven modes
AF-N08-01.premise: In his magic workshop, the obsessive artisan proudly finishes a lamp with seven brightness modes, a calibration dial and a leather-bound manual.

AF-N08-02.label: Ordering a quiet door
AF-N08-02.premise: At the workshop entrance, a customer asks the obsessive magic item artisan for a door that simply opens quietly, and he eagerly unveils his work.

AF-N08-03.label: Costing a pocket warmer
AF-N08-03.premise: At the workshop counter, a merchant asks the obsessive artisan how much his beautiful magical pocket warmer costs to manufacture.

AF-N08-04.label: Installing a prototype
AF-N08-04.premise: In the workshop test area, the obsessive artisan assures the handyman that the prototype works perfectly as long as it is handled correctly.

AF-N08-05.label: A sword that records swings
AF-N08-05.premise: At the forge demonstration table, the obsessive artisan presents a warrior with a sword that records every swing in exquisite detail, while the practical smith looks it over.

AF-N09-01.label: A chest of treasure
AF-N09-01.premise: In a warehouse, the shrewd traveling merchant opens a chest of glittering treasure and begins counting the contents with obvious delight.

AF-N09-02.label: Demonstrating a new product
AF-N09-02.premise: In the merchant's office, an inventor demonstrates a miraculous new product to the shrewd traveling merchant, who leans forward with his questions ready.

AF-N09-03.label: An exclusive hero discount
AF-N09-03.premise: At a market stall, the shrewd merchant offers the hero an exclusive hero discount with tremendous ceremony, while the hero remembers yesterday's prices.

AF-N09-04.label: Exclusive rights to a device
AF-N09-04.premise: In a trade office, the shrewd merchant secures exclusive rights to an inventor's marvelous cleaning device and unrolls a grand expansion map.

AF-N09-05.label: Free snacks for a wolf
AF-N09-05.premise: At a food market, the shrewd merchant gives a legendary wolf familiar a free snack to impress the cook who travels with it.

AF-N10-01.label: Welcoming a newcomer
AF-N10-01.premise: In his study, the kindly patron noble reviews a list of what one newcomer needs to feel comfortable: a spare room, spare clothes, a spare carriage.

AF-N10-02.label: A small introduction
AF-N10-02.premise: In the patron's reception room, the modest newcomer reluctantly accepts the kindly noble's offer of a small introduction to a few people.

AF-N10-03.label: The gift of a workshop
AF-N10-03.premise: In a brand-new workshop, the kindly patron noble presents it as a gift to a grateful craftsperson, who begins looking around with practical eyes.

AF-N10-04.label: A letter of recommendation
AF-N10-04.premise: At the guild desk, the kindly patron noble hands over a glowing recommendation so that the shy hero will receive ordinary, fair treatment from the receptionist.

AF-N10-05.label: Repaying a kindness
AF-N10-05.premise: In the noble drawing room, the hero insists on repaying the kindly patron's generosity, and the patron insists no repayment is necessary.

AF-N11-01.label: Rehearsing a royal welcome
AF-N11-01.premise: In an empty throne room, the summoning king rehearses a grand welcome speech for the chosen hero, then checks his practical list: bed, boots, translator, travel money.

AF-N11-02.label: A suggestion about grain
AF-N11-02.premise: In the throne room, the summoned newcomer offers the king one sensible suggestion about grain storage.

AF-N11-03.label: Questioning a summoned stranger
AF-N11-03.premise: In the summoning hall, the king, eager to continue the ceremony, asks the newly summoned ordinary worker how many armies he has commanded.

AF-N11-04.label: The prophesied holy sword
AF-N11-04.premise: In the royal armory, the summoning king promises that the holy sword will solve all the kingdom's problems, as a practical smith inspects it.

AF-N11-05.label: Who to ask for guidance
AF-N11-05.premise: In the summoning chamber, the king tells the newly summoned hero to consult the goddess whenever uncertainty arises, while the hero recalls her own farewell instructions.

AF-N12-01.label: Drafting a tax exemption
AF-N12-01.premise: In his study, the pompous noble drafts a rule exempting anyone of sufficiently distinguished ancestry from taxes, and starts tracing his elaborate family tree to define it.

AF-N12-02.label: A noble's guild application
AF-N12-02.premise: At the guild counter, the pompous noble recites twelve inherited titles to prove his application deserves special treatment from the receptionist, who applies every rule the same way.

AF-N12-04.label: A monument in the square
AF-N12-04.premise: In the town square, the pompous noble orders a huge monument to celebrate his own generosity, and a farmer steps forward about the village's broken well.

AF-N12-05.label: Boasting before a banquet
AF-N12-05.premise: In the banquet antechamber, the pompous noble boasts that his feast proves the district's prosperity, as an accountant and the village elder, still waiting for repairs, stand by.

AF-N13-01.label: A changed seating plan
AF-N13-01.premise: Alone with a wall of ribbons and notes, the elegant court schemer sets out to trace every political consequence of a suddenly changed lunch seating plan.

AF-N13-02.label: A hint in the corridor
AF-N13-02.premise: In a palace corridor, the elegant court schemer suggests that a certain person might appreciate being seen near a certain doorway at a certain hour, to an outsider who prefers plain instructions.

AF-N13-04.label: A rumour about a merchant
AF-N13-04.premise: In a palace waiting room, the elegant court schemer spreads a careful hint that a merchant has purchased forbidden supplies, within the merchant's hearing.

AF-N13-05.label: Two confidential versions
AF-N13-05.premise: In a palace corridor, the elegant court schemer gives a noble and a prince different confidential versions of the same plan, expecting them to become rivals.

AF-N14-01.label: A sermon against luxury
AF-N14-01.premise: In his office, the scheming bishop prepares a sermon condemning worldly luxury, but his gold ink keeps smearing on the imported velvet paper.

AF-N14-02.label: A goddess visits the temple
AF-N14-02.premise: In the temple office, the scheming bishop assures a visiting goddess that every fee the temple collects fulfils her sacred wishes.

AF-N14-03.label: The appointment list
AF-N14-03.premise: At the temple reception, the scheming bishop preaches that patient faith is rewarded while moving a wealthy noble's name to the top of the appointment list, in front of an earnest healer.

AF-N14-04.label: A forecast from the steps
AF-N14-04.premise: On the temple steps, the scheming bishop predicts that a humble offering will bring clear skies, while the village elder plans the community festival around his word.

AF-N14-05.label: A contract of obedience
AF-N14-05.premise: In the temple meeting room, the scheming bishop proudly unveils a contract requiring everyone to obey the temple's written rules, and a careful accountant and a merchant begin reading it.

AF-N15-01.label: Checking the infirmary cupboard
AF-N15-01.premise: In the community infirmary, the earnest healer nun checks the supply cupboard: one bandage roll, three empty jars and an enormous pile of thank-you notes.

AF-N15-02.label: A warrior's boast
AF-N15-02.premise: In the infirmary, a powerful warrior with a freshly wrapped ankle announces that no enemy can stop him, as the earnest healer nun and a hero look on.

AF-N15-03.label: Purifying the chapel
AF-N15-03.premise: In the chapel, the earnest healer nun asks a mage to help purify the building, and he begins preparing an elaborate ritual against evil.

AF-N15-04.label: A patient returns
AF-N15-04.premise: At the infirmary doorway, the earnest healer nun is delighted when an impulsive adventurer she healed returns with flowers to thank her.

AF-N15-05.label: An offer of sponsorship
AF-N15-05.premise: At the infirmary desk, a well-meaning patron offers to sponsor the earnest nun's healing work in exchange for one tiny favour: a private appointment every morning, forever.

AF-N16-01.label: Labelling a practice spell
AF-N16-01.premise: In an isolated training room, the eccentric sage labels a new practice spell harmless, sets down his pen and prepares to demonstrate it.

AF-N16-02.label: A prodigy's question
AF-N16-02.premise: In his study, the eccentric sage proudly lists every advanced spell his sheltered child prodigy has mastered, and the child raises a hand with a question.

AF-N16-03.label: A light training pack
AF-N16-03.premise: On the training ground, the eccentric sage hands a conventional warrior trainee a training pack he considers pleasantly light.

AF-N16-04.label: Opening an ancient case
AF-N16-04.premise: In the archive, the eccentric sage explains a forgotten magical language with effortless confidence, while the handyman waits to get the protective case open.

AF-N16-05.label: Praising a prodigy's spell
AF-N16-05.premise: In the training yard, the eccentric sage congratulates a prodigy for improving a spell beyond all expectations, while the tutor looks toward the practice targets.

AF-N17-01.label: Polishing a rank badge
AF-N17-01.premise: In his rented room, the boastful rival hero polishes his impressive rank badge until it shines like a miniature sun, while the day's quest waits unopened.

AF-N17-02.label: A challenge to the cook
AF-N17-02.premise: In the camp kitchen, the boastful rival hero challenges the cook to compare combat statistics and draws up a chart to prove his superiority.

AF-N17-03.label: Reporting a glorious deed
AF-N17-03.premise: At the guild desk, the boastful rival hero announces his latest glorious accomplishment to the receptionist and waits for applause.

AF-N17-04.label: Who needs directions
AF-N17-04.premise: At a roadside checkpoint, the boastful rival hero insists that directions are unnecessary for someone of his rank, while the scout studies the marked route.

AF-N17-05.label: Speech on a crate
AF-N17-05.premise: In the guild common room, the boastful rival hero climbs onto a crate to describe his leadership during the latest quest, while the warrior and healer from his team listen.

AF-N18-01.label: Practising an entrance
AF-N18-01.premise: In an empty guild corner, the sneering starter-town bully practises a terrifying entrance in front of a polished shield, with a stool arranged for dramatic effect.

AF-N18-02.label: Picking an easy target
AF-N18-02.premise: In the guild training room, the sneering bully picks the smallest adult tutor in the room for an easy humiliation, boasting about a spell he claims to know.

AF-N18-03.label: A fist on the table
AF-N18-03.premise: In the tavern, the sneering starter-town bully slams a fist on the table to establish dominance, while the keeper watches from behind the counter.

AF-N18-04.label: Threatening a newcomer
AF-N18-04.premise: At the town entrance, the sneering bully tells a newly arrived adventurer that nobody survives this town without his permission.

AF-N18-05.label: Settling it outside
AF-N18-05.premise: At the guild exit, the sneering bully loudly announces he will settle a dispute outside, in front of the receptionist and the guard captain.

AF-N19-01.label: Updating the emergency manual
AF-N19-01.premise: In the guard office, the town guard captain updates the city's emergency manual, working through flood, fire and monster attack toward adventurer-related incidents.

AF-N19-02.label: A hero at the gate
AF-N19-02.premise: At the city gate, the hero arrives carrying an enormous trophy from a great victory and expects the guard captain to open the gates immediately.

AF-N19-03.label: A monster at the checkpoint
AF-N19-03.premise: At the city checkpoint, the guard captain grips his spear and prepares for trouble as a monster chief approaches the gate.

AF-N19-04.label: An immaculate report
AF-N19-04.premise: At the guard station, the town guard captain studies a ninja's immaculate report: no witnesses, no noise, no visible damage, and the ninja standing quietly beside him.

AF-N19-05.label: Planning a victory parade
